title: Megami Kouhosei Special Curriculum: Nakama
justification: The 2002-05-25 OVA Special Curriculum: Nakama is TVDB 72719 season 0 episode 1 Curriculum 12-Friends (2002-05-25) and TMDB 27736 season 0 episode 1 Curriculum 12 Friends; the row sent it to season 1 episode 13, which does not exist (season 1 is Curriculum 00-11, node 253). The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
